records.title: Gib nur acht, über Nacht kommt die Liebe

Auf wiederseh'n, Herr Doktor, auf wiederseh'n, Frau Doktor
records.lyricistAsPrinted: Fritz Rotter (German original); Ferry (Dutch text); B. Kaper (qualified catalogue attribution)
records.publicNote: The 1929 Dutch edition uses the title “Tot Weerziens, Mijnheer Jansen” and explicitly credits Ferry with the Dutch text. For the German original, the U.S. Copyright Office credits words to Fritz Rotter and music to Bronisław Kaper. Images Musicales metadata additionally parses Rotter and Kaper as co-composers and Rotter, Kaper and Ferry as lyricists; those additional role attributions are retained as qualified contributions.

records.title: San Francisco, sur notre terre immense il est un coin
records.publisherAsPrinted: Robbins Music Corporation/1936; Francis Day, Paris 00.00.00–31.12.1977
records.publicNote: Evidence points to more than one French publication context: Buxbaum/Sieghardt records Robbins/Francis Day, while a 1936 French-edition listing names Éditions France Mélodie. The catalogue prints “Didier Alcan Bloch,” whereas the French-edition listing credits Didier Mauprey. BnF confirms Didier Mauprey as a pseudonym of Didier Bloch but does not attest “Didier Alcan Bloch”; that identity resolution remains probable.
